products.name: Vintage Christmas Wrapping Paper

printify.resolution_instruction: Resolve via Printify API before build. Choose the strongest commercially viable wrapping-paper configuration consistent with the approved concept and economics.

products.creative_thesis: A genuinely beautiful mid-century Christmas wrapping paper that looks discovered in a perfectly preserved 1950s department-store archive.
products.production_art_brief: Create a seamless premium Christmas repeat pattern inspired by authentic 1940s-1950s American holiday illustration: hand-painted vintage ornaments, stylized evergreen sprigs, small wrapped presents, elegant stars, tasteful bows, subtle snowflake accents and occasional whimsical mid-century holiday shapes. Palette: deep holly green, warm antique red, soft cream, muted gold, tiny touches of icy blue. Nostalgic but sophisticated, not kitschy. Use varied scale and spacing so the repeat feels designed rather than tiled. No copyrighted characters, brand names, recognizable commercial Santa mascot, generic modern clipart, aggressive faux distress, or required text. Must work as a true seamless repeat; check tile edges before production.

higgsfield_prompts.hero: Reference-lock to the exact final wrapping paper product and final approved printed pattern. Create a premium Christmas gifting campaign photograph. Several beautifully wrapped gifts using the exact wrapping-paper design sit beneath a sophisticated natural Christmas tree in a warm upscale living room. The HERO gift is large enough for the paper pattern to be immediately readable. Warm evening window and tree light, tasteful velvet ribbon, natural evergreen, subtle brass accents, editorial holiday styling. Camera: slightly low three-quarter angle. Lens feel: premium lifestyle editorial, shallow but useful depth of field. The wrapping paper must be the visual hero. No text overlays, logos, altered pattern, extra wrapping-paper designs, cheap stock-photo aesthetic, or AI-looking hands.
higgsfield_prompts.detail: Use the exact final printed wrapping-paper design. Create an elegant macro-detail photograph of one beautifully wrapped gift. Focus on the print quality, repeating illustrations, paper surface and folded corners. A tasteful ribbon may cross the package but must not hide the design. Warm cream tabletop, evergreen clipping softly out of focus, premium Christmas editorial lighting. No text, pattern modifications, or invented metallic foil unless the actual Printify product has metallic foil.
higgsfield_prompts.lifestyle: Reference-lock to the exact paper. Create a realistic overhead lifestyle image of someone wrapping a Christmas gift at a beautiful holiday worktable. Show the actual paper roll/sheet, scissors, ribbon and partially wrapped box. The wrapping paper design must remain identical to the production artwork. Premium natural-home Christmas styling, warm morning light, sophisticated—not craft-store clutter. No logos, excessive props, or random alternate patterns.
higgsfield_prompts.value: Use only the approved wrapping-paper design. Create an aspirational stack of differently sized Christmas presents all wrapped in the exact same paper, using complementary ribbons in cream, green and muted red. Neutral upscale home background, softly lit Christmas tree behind. Make the repeated print clearly visible across different package sizes. No text, extra patterns, or fake product packaging.

products.name: Cozy Reading Club Black Mug

printify.resolution_instruction: Resolve via Printify API. Use a quality black mug with viable print area and economics.

products.creative_thesis: A mug that feels like it belongs in a members-only reading room after midnight.
products.production_art_brief: Create a premium old-library emblem for readers. Central visual: elegant open book integrated with a tiny glowing reading lamp and subtle crescent moon motif. Supporting elements: small stars, restrained botanical flourishes, tiny ornamental linework. Typography: COZY READING CLUB. Style: vintage literary society insignia meets upscale independent bookstore. Ink colors: warm ivory/bone with subtle muted antique-gold accent against black. If generated typography is imperfect, rebuild deterministically. No cartoon books, generic Canva clipart, coffee-shop clichés, copyrighted literary references, or author quotes.

higgsfield_prompts.hero: Reference-lock to the exact final black mug and final artwork. Create a premium editorial product photograph of the mug on a dark walnut side table next to an open hardcover book in an elegant home-library setting. Warm reading lamp glow. Deep shelves softly blurred behind. A textured chair or blanket may appear subtly. Camera: intimate three-quarter mug-level angle. The mug and artwork must be crisp and clearly readable. No changed artwork, added text, unrealistic steam shapes, or fake book titles.
higgsfield_prompts.lifestyle: Use the exact final mug. Create a realistic cozy-night scene of a reader holding the mug while sitting in a comfortable reading chair with a book open in the other hand. Focus primarily on the mug. Warm amber lamp light, dark moody library atmosphere, cinematic but believable. Do not alter the printed design. No visible copyrighted book cover or text overlays.
higgsfield_prompts.detail: Reference-lock to the real mug and print. Create a close commercial image emphasizing the printed emblem on the black ceramic surface. Show realistic ceramic gloss and print texture with subtle warm reflections. Minimal dark-library background. No distortion of lettering or additional graphics.
higgsfield_prompts.value: Create a premium gift-oriented scene with the exact mug beside a tasteful stack of neutral books, reading glasses and a simple gift box/ribbon. Elegant reading-room environment. The final product should feel like a $25-$30 intentional reader gift, not generic merch. No fake gift message, extra mugs, or altered artwork.

products.name: Fall Porch / Halloween House Banner

printify.resolution_instruction: Resolve exact banner/flag configuration via Printify API. Do not substitute a materially different format without preserving the approved porch-display concept.

products.creative_thesis: An atmospheric October cottage sceme someone would genuinely want hanging outside their home—not Halloween clipart.
products.production_art_brief: Create a richly illustrated autumn cottage-at-dusk scene: charming old cottage with glowing amber windows surrounded by pumpkins, dried grasses, falling leaves and subtle evening mist. Include one or two tiny friendly vintage-style ghost figures integrated naturally, not giant cartoon mascots. Sky: deep muted twilight blue. Palette: burnt orange, tobacco brown, warm cream, dusty sage, deep blue-black, amber light. Mood: storybook, cozy, mysterious, premium. Avoid bright neon Halloween colors, generic jack-o'-lantern clipart, gore, recognizable characters, or busy typography. No text required.

higgsfield_prompts.hero: Reference-lock to the exact final Printify banner/flag and artwork. Create a premium exterior lifestyle photograph of the banner displayed naturally on a beautifully styled autumn front porch. Include believable pumpkins, mums, warm lanterns and fallen leaves. The banner must be large, correctly proportioned and clearly visible. Early evening golden/twilight light. Upscale cottagecore fall campaign photography. No altered artwork, second competing banner, text overlays, or impossible mounting.
higgsfield_prompts.lifestyle: Use the exact final banner. Create a wider exterior image showing how the banner enhances the entry of a tasteful suburban or cottage-style home during fall. Keep the banner recognizable even in the wider composition. Natural seasonal decor, believable scale, premium real-estate/editorial quality. No Halloween theme-park styling or altered product.
higgsfield_prompts.detail: Create a close photograph of the actual banner fabric and printed illustration, showing real textile texture, seam/edge construction and the artwork clearly. Soft autumn porch background. No fake embroidery, invented materials, or text.
higgsfield_prompts.value: Reference-lock to exact art. Show the banner on the porch around blue hour with warm exterior lantern lighting and subtle seasonal ambiance. Do not make the banner itself glow. The printed cottage windows remain printed artwork, not actual lights. Cinematic but completely believable.

products.name: Book-Night Velveteen Blanket

printify.resolution_instruction: Known prior candidate. Verify this remains optimal via current API data before build.

products.creative_thesis: An entire cozy reading-night world, not simply words printed on a blanket.
products.production_art_brief: Create a richly illustrated nighttime reading-room environment designed as a full blanket composition: deep cozy library, oversized armchair, stacked books, warm table lamp, small rain-streaked window, subtle moon outside, tea cup, botanical accents and quiet star motifs. Palette: deep navy, plum-brown, amber gold, cream and muted forest green. Strong central reading nook with supporting details extending toward edges without awkward crops. No recognizable book titles, author quotes, copyrighted characters, or generic repeating clipart.

higgsfield_prompts.hero: Reference-lock to the exact finished velveteen blanket and artwork. Create a premium cozy-bedroom/living-room photograph with the blanket draped beautifully across a reading chair or edge of a bed. The printed artwork must be clearly visible and remain exact. Warm reading lamp, rainy evening atmosphere outside, real soft textile texture. Camera: medium three-quarter angle. Premium home-textile advertising. No altered artwork, fake embroidery, or text overlay.
higgsfield_prompts.lifestyle: Use exact blanket. Create a reader curled comfortably under the blanket in a cozy chair with a book. Frame the blanket so a large recognizable portion of the artwork is visible. Warm intimate nighttime light. No visible copyrighted book cover, distorted print, or artificial glowing fabric.
higgsfield_prompts.detail: Macro detail of the actual velveteen surface and printed artwork. Show realistic fibers, softness and color reproduction. A hand lightly touching/folding one corner is okay. No claims like 'ultra soft' rendered as text or invented stitching.
higgsfield_prompts.value: Create a premium giftable reading-nook image with the exact blanket folded neatly beside a reading chair, books and a simple ribbon/gift presentation. Make it feel like a high-quality literary lifestyle gift. No added branding or extra blanket patterns.

products.name: Vintage Halloween Kitchen Towel

printify.resolution_instruction: Known prior executable substrate. Verify current availability/cost before creation.

products.creative_thesis: A charming vintage October kitchen illustration that looks collectible rather than novelty-store cheap.
products.production_art_brief: Create a vintage editorial Halloween kitchen illustration inspired by mid-century cookbook and seasonal advertising art. Main subject: cheerful vintage ghost chef preparing an autumn pie or arranging fall ingredients on a kitchen counter. Supporting details: small pumpkins, apples, pie tin, flour jar, wooden spoon, subtle stars and harvest leaves. Style: hand-painted / screen-print-inspired vintage illustration. Palette: aged cream, pumpkin orange, black, warm mustard, muted olive. Optional headline: OCTOBER KITCHEN; if typography is not perfect, rebuild deterministically. No copyrighted characters, modern chef logos, gore, or cheesy cartoon clipart.

higgsfield_prompts.hero: Reference-lock to the exact final towel and artwork. Create a premium warm kitchen photograph with the towel hanging naturally from an oven handle or decorative rail. Autumn kitchen environment, small pumpkins, warm wood and cream surfaces. The design must be unobstructed and readable. Natural fall morning light. No alternate towel designs, text overlays, or distorted towel proportions.
higgsfield_prompts.lifestyle: Show the exact towel folded casually on a beautiful kitchen counter beside an autumn pie and tasteful baking utensils. Premium seasonal editorial styling. The print remains visible. No fake food branding or changed design.
higgsfield_prompts.detail: Create a close commercial photograph emphasizing the real towel weave, printed ghost-chef illustration and stitching/edge. Realistic textile detail. No fake embroidery or invented material claims.
higgsfield_prompts.value: Create a premium autumn hostess-gift composition using the exact towel folded with a wooden spoon, simple ribbon and small neutral gift basket. Warm sophisticated fall kitchen. No gift text or random branding.

products.name: Game-Day Can Cooler Collection

printify.resolution_instruction: Resolve live via Printify API before production. Determine final retail after live base cost + US shipping.

ip_rule: No official colors presented as a team identity
products.creative_thesis: Game-day graphics that feel like cool independent tailgate merchandise without relying on team IP.
products.production_art_brief: Build as a small cohesive collection. First design direction: SATURDAY PARKING LOT CLUB. Visual system: vintage parking-lot ticket / credential aesthetic, simplified football-field markers, small generic football icon, subtle folding chair / cooler / grill references, and worn-but-premium collegiate-adjacent typography without imitating a specific university. Palette: cream, black, muted rust, forest or navy used generically. If typography is used, build it deterministically so it is exact. No copyrighted marks.

higgsfield_prompts.hero: Reference-lock to the exact final can cooler and final artwork. Create a premium game-day tailgate photograph with the cooler around a plain unbranded beverage can on a clean tailgate table. Background: tasteful football tailgate environment, folding chairs, grill and stadium/parking atmosphere softly blurred. Product dominates foreground. Late-afternoon game-day light. No team logos, jerseys with names/numbers, branded cans, or copyrighted stadium signage.
higgsfield_prompts.lifestyle: Use the exact can cooler. Show an adult hand holding the cooler around a plain beverage can during a lively but tasteful tailgate gathering. Keep product crisp. People blurred naturally behind. Generic football atmosphere only. No team branding anywhere, visible alcohol brand, or copyrighted marks.
higgsfield_prompts.detail: Create a close clean product photograph showing the exact printed artwork, material texture, seams and can fit. Neutral tailgate tabletop background. No changed typography or extra graphics.
higgsfield_prompts.value: If multiple approved generic game-day variations are built, show the real variations neatly arranged together around plain unbranded cans. If only one design is produced, show multiple units of that exact design instead. Outdoor tailgate tabletop, premium editorial composition. No school colors intentionally grouped to mimic a real team, logos, or text overlays.
